cutscene_intro.prompt: Opening cutscene of the world of "Neon Drift Circuit", a synthwave arcade kart racing game. The camera slowly pushes in and glides over the world, revealing the level, then the hero character appears and strikes a confident pose. Synthwave palette: deep indigo night, hot magenta and cyan neon, a giant striped setting sun bleeding orange-pink on the horizon. stylised 3D video game cinematic, same characters, world and art style as the image, smooth camera, vivid colour. Upbeat adventurous music.

The hero celebrates the win, jumping and cheering, confetti and sparkles burst around, warm triumphant light, the camera circles slowly. Joyful fanfare.
